one thousand voices.name: One Thousand Voices
one thousand voices.notes: extremely easy damage option, arguably not worth it given surrounding alternatives but still decent
one thousand voices.description: delayed scorching explosive bolts, DoT Taken seeker on explosions, 2x tick damage if Witherhoarded

parasite.name: Parasite
parasite.notes: 15% non-power boost is less relevant now, but still has some use cases
parasite.description: 20 stack rank-dependent kill counter, up to 3x damage, self-damage gives 15% damage to other weapons for 10s, has Envious Arsenal

praxic blade.name: Praxic Blade
praxic blade.notes: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal
praxic blade.description: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts

alethonym.name: Alethonym
alethonym.notes: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option
alethonym.description: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups

anarchy.name: Anarchy
anarchy.notes: BiS total tick option for sustained special damage, also good for trapping doors
anarchy.description: 6 linkable stickable traps that tick between them and explode on expiry, has Jolting Feedback and Impromptu Ammunition

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.notes: decent sustained option, decent for roam, has exclusive high 12P variant for melee strategies
bastion.description: pellet fusion that gives +300% melee damage on hits, also has Trench Barrel-esque buff, has Cast No Shadows

d.a.r.c.i..name: D.A.R.C.I.
d.a.r.c.i..notes: nowhere near as beneficial vs. Gjally for rockets, but still useful for large fireteam sniper DPS
d.a.r.c.i..description: shows HP amounts, jolts, and stacks damage buff on long ADS crits, also gives teammates stacking legendary sniper 15.9% buff

edge of action.name: Edge of Action
edge of action.notes: 5% stackable is nice, especially given swap potential, not a bad defensive tool either
edge of action.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire deployable bubble, gives 45 HP Void OS and 5% stackable weapon damage for 10s on dip

euphony.name: Euphony
euphony.notes: good sustained special damage with Pack Tactics
euphony.description: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits

heirloom.name: Heirloom
heirloom.notes: surprisingly excellent splash damage per shot, DoT option for Envious, just has long charge time
heirloom.description: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent

tessellation.name: Tessellation
tessellation.notes: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst
tessellation.description: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect

the fourth horseman.name: The Fourth Horseman
the fourth horseman.notes: very easy instant miniboss burst, usable for damage as well
the fourth horseman.description: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy

turncoat.name: Turncoat
turncoat.notes: usable for roam due to artifact, otherwise situationally useful for extremely optimized rocket dumping
turncoat.description: EP every 3 shots, meter charged on hits/kills, consume to give fire rate, infinite ammo/EP, weaken, transferable stackable buff

wavesplitter.name: Wavesplitter
wavesplitter.notes: probably the best exotic add clear trace in artifact context
wavesplitter.description: cycles power on sustained fire, orb pickup gives max power for 10s and refills, suppresses on 12 max power hits, has AO + Detonator Beam

ager's scepter.name: Ager's Scepter
ager's scepter.notes: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace
ager's scepter.description: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS

arbalest.name: Arbalest
arbalest.notes: completely powercrept stun-wise, useful for guaranteed boss-level shield break
arbalest.description: guaranteed shield break of any type, Disruption Break

buried bloodline.name: Buried Bloodline
buried bloodline.notes: only non-artifact/subclass source of Devour besides RoN 4pc. for challenges
buried bloodline.description: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour

collective obligation.name: Collective Obligation
collective obligation.description: stores void debuffs from targets or makes them every 27 hits, alt fire to apply debuffs and +20% damage, refill on void buffs, has Repulsor Brace

cull's shadow.name: Cull's Shadow
cull's shadow.notes: tick option for Envious, melee stacking neutral is decent
cull's shadow.description: aggressive fusion with blades that take melee buffs, applies DoT via shots after 2 melees, ticked enemies make crystals on death

delicate tomb.name: Delicate Tomb
delicate tomb.notes: better instant Ionic Trace source than Coldheart, worse ammo economy though
delicate tomb.description: 16 bolt burst, 20% damage on hipfire, Ionic Trace chance on kill (guaranteed if elite+), 2x damage jolting shot and 4 ammo refill on trace pickup

dragon's breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragon's breath.notes: underrated swap DPS option, has unique Firesprite bypass use case
dragon's breath.description: refills on 2 ignitions, damage and longer embed based on stacks, spawns Firesprites on kill and bypasses cooldown

finality's auger.name: Finality's Auger
finality's auger.notes: outclassed by Anarchy, better super generation but not relevant any more, can be placed inside doors
finality's auger.description: alt fire deployable turret that can paint targets to deal more damage, has regular LFR mode, has Bait and Switch

graviton lance.name: Graviton Lance
graviton lance.notes: pretty strong with artiifact, more lethal but less debuff-focused Collective Obligation competitor
graviton lance.description: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout

ice breaker.name: Ice Breaker
ice breaker.notes: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds
ice breaker.description: custom sniper frame, generates ammo from non-Ice Breaker kills or stasis-debuffed hits, ignition on crit or frozen shatter

khvostov 7g-0x.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
khvostov 7g-0x.notes: great for contest-like environments for spreading assist credit and getting ammo, also generally potent in solos
khvostov 7g-0x.description: ricocheting auto, orbs give 7 enhanced ricocheting bullets that bounce 7 times, has Shoot to Loot + Attrition Orbs

legend of acrius.name: Legend of Acrius
legend of acrius.notes: simple and consistent melee damage option, similar to high tier swords
legend of acrius.description: massive spread overpenetrating pellets, has a grounded damage instance, has Trench Barrel

necrochasm.name: Necrochasm
necrochasm.notes: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong
necrochasm.description: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant

new malpais.name: New Malpais
new malpais.notes: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously
new malpais.description: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation

prometheus lens.name: Prometheus Lens
prometheus lens.notes: besides unique ammo gen, certainly not the strongest exotic add clear trace
prometheus lens.description: scorching field on sustained damage, 75 ammo refill on kill, has Incandescent

salvation's grip.name: Salvation's Grip
salvation's grip.notes: only useful for DSM and terrain generation requirements in challenges
salvation's grip.description: charged shots shoot crystal formation, uncharged shots break crystals, 25% damage to frozen enemies, has Rimestealer

the lament.name: The Lament
the lament.notes: higher QoL but worse damage version of Wolfsbane
the lament.description: 7HP on damage tick (includes scorch), special blocking revving mechanic that amps damage, has Burning Ambition

the navigator.name: The Navigator
the navigator.notes: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)
the navigator.description: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload

trinity ghoul.name: Trinity Ghoul
trinity ghoul.notes: scales very poorly into low power content, but still has some use for easy spread chained add clear
trinity ghoul.description: 3 split arrows, arc kills give next shot chain lightning

vex mythoclast.name: Vex Mythoclast
vex mythoclast.notes: easily best single target primary ever produced in sandbox context, but niche in endgame is still small
vex mythoclast.description: fusion interactions, 6 kills (T3+ doubled) for crit kill igniting LFR mode, 20% damage for 5s on sustained fire or kill, has Rewind Rounds variant

vexcalibur.name: Vexcalibur
vexcalibur.notes: underrated, probably best purely defensive exotic, just struggles to activate overshield refresh in low power
vexcalibur.description: special 5 bolt spread, +25% projectile damage to Vex, blocking gives Void OS to allies within 15m, glaive melee kills give full OS while OS is active

whirling ovation.name: Whirling Ovation
whirling ovation.notes: already struggled to differentiate itself from Parasite during rocket pulse meta, maybe useful for some optimized finals
whirling ovation.description: time-scaled strand/solar damage that charges faster as damage is done with other weapons, solar grenade on minor/elite pierce

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
wolfsbane.notes: most relevant melee range easy sustained damage option
wolfsbane.description: charges meter on hits and kills, can consume to activate overclocked mode with scorching cyclones, has variable catalysts

bad juju.name: Bad Juju
bad juju.notes: super generation niche surpassed by artifact setup, add clear profile underrated though
bad juju.description: hugely increased super generation on stacking kill perk, also has cursed thrall explosion on 3 kills

cerberus+1.name: Cerberus+1
cerberus+1.notes: basically just for breaking crystals and maybe Calus skulls
cerberus+1.description: pellet auto with 50% damage perk on special kill-reload

cloudstrike.name: Cloudstrike
cloudstrike.notes: outclassed by legendary snipers, lightning strike is used in just RoN 3rd
cloudstrike.description: Bolt Charge (x5 on kill) and lightning strike on 3 crits or crit kill, has Triple Tap

coldheart.name: Coldheart
coldheart.notes: best sustained Ionic Trace source in the game, however not the most applicable use case
coldheart.description: sustained damage and Ionic Traces give energy, spawns Ionic Trace every 2s at max energy, has Supercharged Magazine

conditional finality.name: Conditional Finality
conditional finality.notes: good chunks and high QoL for roam, but no crazy outlier behavior for endgame
conditional finality.description: stasis/solar 2 mag shotgun that freezes and ignites with respective shots

duality.name: Duality
duality.notes: very solid sustained DPS for a special but nothing standout
duality.description: pellet kill or most pellets hit stack 3x up to 54.7% slug crit damage for 10.5s, slug crits refresh duration

eriana's vow.name: Eriana's Vow
eriana's vow.notes: good for killing individual potentially shielded enemies, otherwise useless
eriana's vow.description: 32.5% damage on first scoped shot, buff disappears after body shot, ignition on matching or champion shield break, has ALH

ex diris.name: Ex Diris
ex diris.notes: weapon-based Amplified, can be used to die, add clear and damage aren't good
ex diris.description: scaling fire rate increase on hits (maxed on crit health), spawns moth on 2 hits (3s ICD), Amplified on kill

eyes of tomorrow.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
eyes of tomorrow.notes: slow but technically has infinite ammo power-level add clear
eyes of tomorrow.description: 6 individually tracking rockets, 4 kills with one volley gives 50% damage buff and 1 ammo refund, has Demolitionist and Blast Distributor

fighting lion.name: Fighting Lion
fighting lion.notes: usable for certain builds due to artifact (void/Weakened Clear)
fighting lion.description: volatile burst on hit, refill on non-Fighting Lion kill within 6s of dealing damage

final warning.name: Final Warning
final warning.notes: in theory a strong damage profile but a little unwieldy to use
final warning.description: tracking/hitscan hybrid sidearm that can mark enemies to do 2x crit damage and fully charge to unravel

forerunner.name: Forerunner
forerunner.notes: The Rock has crazy scaling with grenade buffs but otherwise not relevant for add clear
forerunner.description: insane crit multi special sidearm, has special kill-reload that replaces grenade with frag that scales with grenade buffs

grand overture.name: Grand Overture
grand overture.notes: outdated damage, total not even that impressive, too slow for add clear
grand overture.description: slug launcher that loads up to 20 blinding missiles on hit that explode on kill, alt fire to change modes and fire missile burst

heartshadow.name: Heartshadow
heartshadow.notes: niche debuff extension option for sword damage, otherwise not very useful
heartshadow.description: weaken on hit, 25% damage, and move speed while invisible, invisibility on grounded powered heavy

le monarque.name: Le Monarque
le monarque.notes: only notable due to Storm's Keep interaction
le monarque.description: fully drawn crits leave fast ticking poison, has Unrelenting

lord of wolves.name: Lord of Wolves
lord of wolves.notes: completely outclassed by both legendary and exotic special alternatives, unique ammo gen stat
lord of wolves.description: 5 shot bursts, hipfire causes scorching shots, ADS causes scorching explosion on kill

lumina.name: Lumina
lumina.notes: grappling eclipsed by Alethonym and rockets, damage buff succeeded by Boots of the Assembler
lumina.description: 2 Noble Rounds on kill, hipfire to give 35% damage buff and 100 Class to wielder and ally for 11s

microcosm.name: Microcosm
microcosm.notes: shield health use case is extremely rare and Arbalest exists, damage profile is awful
microcosm.description: huge bonus to shields, refill and 20% damage for 20s on super, has Thresh and rank-dependent buffed super gains

monte carlo.name: Monte Carlo
monte carlo.notes: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics
monte carlo.description: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet

new land beyond.name: New Land Beyond
new land beyond.notes: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche
new land beyond.description: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks

osteo striga.name: Osteo Striga
osteo striga.notes: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too
osteo striga.description: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag

rat king.name: Rat King
rat king.notes: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad
rat king.description: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King

red death reformed.name: Red Death Reformed
red death reformed.notes: held back by frame, great survivability but poor lethality, doesn't really fit current endgame playstyle
red death reformed.description: Cure x2 on kill, Cure x1 to allies on kill-reload, scaling damage as HP gets lower, healing orb on 3 weapon kill counter

riskrunner.name: Riskrunner
riskrunner.notes: Arc shield is sometimes useful for certain solos, otherwise Arc Conductor trigger requirement too situational
riskrunner.description: 50% arc resist and chain lightning on incoming arc damage, has Chain Reaction

service of luzaku.name: Service of Luzaku
service of luzaku.notes: only relic droppable interact, otherwise waste of exotic heavy slot
service of luzaku.description: support frame mechanics, threadling-spawning nests on kills, can be healed, harvestable after 6 threadlings spawned

skyburner's oath.name: Skyburner's Oath
skyburner's oath.notes: solid laid-back ignition spam option, but very slow playstyle
skyburner's oath.description: scorching hipfire projectiles, has Incandescent and Burning Ambition, +11% damage to Cabal

slayer's fang.name: Slayer's Fang
slayer's fang.notes: can be used for add clear due to ammo economy changes, decent artifact synergy, just lacks range
slayer's fang.description: bouncing submunition shots, 15% crit damage, weaken, and partial refill on kill or Void Breach pickup, +10% damage to Fallen/Scorn

sleeper simulant.name: Sleeper Simulant
sleeper simulant.notes: completely outclassed by plenty of other easy damage options
sleeper simulant.description: overpenetrating low crit multi shots that split into 5 reflecting lasers

sunshot.name: Sunshot
sunshot.notes: slight range issues compared to better exotic primaries, little to no artifact synergy, less consistent in lower power
sunshot.description: explosive HC with low scorch high damage explosion on kill, has Loose Change

tarrabah.name: Tarrabah
tarrabah.notes: Ravenous Beast buffs provide high uptime and unique niche, high ammo gen too
tarrabah.description: stores damage instances, then consumes for ~2x damage and fire rate buff with 50% solar resist, has Ambitious Assassin

the chaperone.name: The Chaperone
the chaperone.notes: very easy shotgun spam damage, worse than all optimized specials though
the chaperone.description: rapid slug with 22% damage and fire rate buff on 2 crits or 1 crit kill, has Triple Tap

the huckleberry.name: The Huckleberry
the huckleberry.notes: one of the best 100 ammo gen weapons, unfortuantely definitely lacking in lethality vs. better primaries
the huckleberry.description: ramping fire rate SMG with 3 kill counter 66% damage perk and Kinetic Tremors

the wardcliff coil.name: The Wardcliff Coil
the wardcliff coil.notes: still has small niche for non-boss classed bosses, otherwise useless
the wardcliff coil.description: 8 scattered tracking mini rockets, Bolt Charge every 2 rockets, refills on heavy pickup

third iteration.name: Third Iteration
third iteration.notes: gameplay loop way too slow despite being void, can be used for tormentors in challenges but very small niche
third iteration.description: spread projectiles, condensed round that marks after ADS time, marked targets take +95% spread shot damage

thunderlord.name: Thunderlord
thunderlord.notes: terrible for boss DPS, outclassed for roam by abilities and weapons galore
thunderlord.description: ramping fire rate, lightning strike every 10 hits or kill that refills 5 ammo and gives Bolt Charge

traveler's chosen.name: Traveler's Chosen
traveler's chosen.notes: only niche is regenerating abilities post-swap, but still requires 10 kills
traveler's chosen.description: 10 stack kill counter, consume to get 10% of every ability per stack, has Osmosis

verglas curve.name: Verglas Curve
verglas curve.notes: used for making hiding spot crystals in challenges and line spots in speedruns, otherwise very slow neutral
verglas curve.description: 5 stack kill counter that makes freezing crystal shots on hipfire, size scales with stacks, +50% damage to frozen enemies

whisper of the worm.name: Whisper of the Worm
whisper of the worm.notes: completely outclassed by all sorts of linears and snipers
whisper of the worm.description: 35% crit damage on long ADS shots, has Triple Tap with full mag refill

winterbite.name: Winterbite
winterbite.notes: technically has some sort of sustain loop with Rimestealer but other glaives are likely better for melee builds
winterbite.description: slow orb that freezes and explodes on impact, increased damage slowing melees, has Rimestealer

wish-ender.name: Wish-Ender
wish-ender.notes: slow draw time on an already low uptime archetype, damage isn't special and no splash effect
wish-ender.description: overpenetrating 3 instance shots, Truesight on ADS, +25% against Witherhoarded enemies, +10% to Taken enemies, has One for All

witherhoard.name: Witherhoard
witherhoard.notes: basically just used for Envious DoT
witherhoard.description: projectile either sticks enemies and applies DoT or creates blight pool on ground, has buffed ALH

worldline zero.name: Worldline Zero
worldline zero.notes: occasionally used for Blade Focus purposes in speedrunning, otherwise basically useless
worldline zero.description: special heavy blink mode that chains on kills after 1s of sprinting

xenophage.name: Xenophage
xenophage.notes: Oracles encounter one trick, not used for anything else
xenophage.description: slow-firing explosive rounds, has Chain Reaction and Rampage

ace of spades.name: Ace of Spades
ace of spades.notes: mathematically better than a good legendary kinetic 140 but not by much
ace of spades.description: standard 140 HC with buffed Firefly and 68% damage for 6 shots on kill-reload

barrow-dyad.name: Barrow-Dyad
barrow-dyad.notes: no special synergies, PKs niche is gone, nothing worth exotic slot
barrow-dyad.description: refilling SMG that stores blight into 6 high-damage seekers upon doing normal damage

black talon.name: Black Talon
black talon.notes: awful damage profile for boss DPS, roam has little use besides suppression source
black talon.description: ranged double cast suppressing void slash heavy attacks, splashes suppress on slash kills

borealis.name: Borealis
borealis.notes: high damage per shot with Ionic Return but really never worth using
borealis.description: element-swappable, matched effect gives 30% damage for 10s, matching shield break gives 37% crit shot, has Shield Disorient

centrifuse.name: Centrifuse
centrifuse.notes: movement gimmick is annoying, likely overshadowed by legendary arc autos
centrifuse.description: sprinting refills, movement and shooting build charge, kills have charge-scaled explosion damage/radius, no decay while Amplified

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.notes: high ammo gen but extremely outdated kit and LP stacking not relevant any more
crimson.description: 3-burst HC that gives 32 HP and starts regen on kill, refills on crit kill

cryosthesia 77k.name: Cryosthesia 77K
cryosthesia 77k.notes: freeze shot no longer relevant for challenges given prominence of freeze options
cryosthesia 77k.description: freezing shot on special kill-reload, refill on frozen kill

dead man's tale.name: Dead Man's Tale
dead man's tale.notes: held back by frame, single target nature, not that special
dead man's tale.description: aggressive scout that has up to 17% damage perk, 27% hipfire damage, and hipfire rate on crits

deathbringer.name: Deathbringer
deathbringer.notes: outclassed in boss DPS and for add clear
deathbringer.description: slow void orb that splits into 7 falling tracking projectiles, damage scales off travel time

deterministic chaos.name: Deterministic Chaos
deterministic chaos.notes: not worth using over legendary void LMG, debuff extension just worse than Withering or Fafnir
deterministic chaos.description: volatile every 4th shot, weaken every 32nd shot (bugged), refills 12 ammo on weaken shot release, has Target Lock

devil's ruin.name: Devil's Ruin
devil's ruin.notes: no CD bypass like Dragon's Breath, not as consistently lethal as better exotic primaries
devil's ruin.description: Firesprite on kill, high damage scorching charged laser on special reload after Firesprite pickup, has Collective Action

edge of concurrence.name: Edge of Concurrence
edge of concurrence.notes: seeker does a lot of damage but uptime is way too low
edge of concurrence.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire jolting chaining lightning seeker

edge of intent.name: Edge of Intent
edge of intent.notes: more useful than Concurrence but uptime is surprisingly not that great
edge of intent.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire 9s healing turret that gives Cure and Restoration to allies every 3s, ToF gives x2 to recipient

graviton spike.name: Graviton Spike
graviton spike.notes: cool concept and on-hit splash is good, unfortunately still too slow for endgame standards
graviton spike.description: alt fire toggleable arc lightning strike or stasis crystal spawner modes, overcharge other mode every 3 crits, 20% damage for overcharging both

hard light.name: Hard Light
hard light.notes: can be used for specific lineups to start encounters, otherwise basically useless
hard light.description: element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage, double ricochet, ricocheted bullets do 2x damage, has Light Touch

hawkmoon.name: Hawkmoon
hawkmoon.notes: similar situation to Dead Man's Tale
hawkmoon.description: crit stacking damage HC with high damage final round based on stacks

heir apparent.name: Heir Apparent
heir apparent.notes: arc shield melts quickly in endgame content, damage is terrible
heir apparent.description: 1.5s spin-up period, creates 75% DR 80 HP arc donut shield if at full HP after ramping, refills half of mag when shield is destroyed

jötunn.name: Jötunn
jötunn.notes: awful damage profile, terrible add clear, slow pace
jötunn.description: tracking explosive projectile that leaves burning spot, has Cornered and Incandescent

lodestar.name: Lodestar
lodestar.notes: struggles against legendary traces with Harsh Refraction, not remarkable besides primary status
lodestar.description: either hipfire normal trace or ADS pulse mode that explodes on arc-debuffed kills, jolt on hit mode after charging meter via arc hits

lorentz driver.name: Lorentz Driver
lorentz driver.notes: marking gimmick is very slow tempo vs. current pace of endgame field, also not even that potent
lorentz driver.description: implosion on crit kill, marked targets spawn telemetries on death, 6 ammo, 50% damage, and body shot implosions for 30s on 3 pickups

malfeasance.name: Malfeasance
malfeasance.notes: LP use case is long gone, damage profile is mediocre, no synergy
malfeasance.description: explosion on 5 hits, +25% to Taken and +25% to Witherhoarded enemies

mida multi-tool.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
mida multi-tool.notes: awful damage profile, has some utility for move speed boosts with relics
mida multi-tool.description: +12.5% move speed, 4-tier buff that stacks on MIDA kills, scales to +14.4% damage and explosive shots

no time to explain.name: No Time to Explain
no time to explain.notes: terrible damage profile and dated add clear effect
no time to explain.description: 10 crits or stasis-debuffed hits spawn buddy turret

outbreak perfected.name: Outbreak Perfected
outbreak perfected.notes: very slow exotic effect, awful for damage, super generation is nuked
outbreak perfected.description: 12 crits spawn nanites, eventually scaling to 4x damage, nanite swarm spawned on kills

polaris lance.name: Polaris Lance
polaris lance.notes: gameplay loop too slow for endgame viability
polaris lance.description: scorching solar round after 4 crits, refunds shot if crit, has Dragonfly

quicksilver storm.name: Quicksilver Storm
quicksilver storm.notes: on-hit stacking effect is way too slow for current exotic weapon field
quicksilver storm.description: Nanotech Tracer Missiles version, landing hits eventually loads special reload grenade that makes tangle on kill

revision zero.name: Revision Zero
revision zero.notes: strong single target, Hunter's Trace shots do a lot, but doesn't find a niche
revision zero.description: meter filled on crits, consumed to give sniper shots that spawn kinetic shockwaves, has FTTC

ruinous effigy.name: Ruinous Effigy
ruinous effigy.notes: actually decent with artifact support but Wavesplitter is just better
ruinous effigy.description: damage field slammable relic dropped on kill, 30% damage for 7s on relic kill or miniboss+ relic damage

sturm.name: Sturm
sturm.notes: very unremarkable exotic effect, purely single target
sturm.description: energy weapon refill on kill, Together Forever kills load overcharged rounds (more on multikills) that do up to 4x damage

suros regime.name: SUROS Regime
suros regime.notes: purely single target, ammo effect is not nearly good enough
suros regime.description: either stable fire rate + extra heavy progress or ramping fire rate + extra special progress, has modified HIR and 50% chance to heal on kill

sweet business.name: Sweet Business
sweet business.notes: terrible minor DPS even when ramped, nothing else special
sweet business.description: ramping fire rate and massive mag, occasional explosive round, refill on brick pickup

symmetry.name: Symmetry
symmetry.notes: has unique interaction with scalable Bolt Charge, but still insanely slow tempo weapon
symmetry.description: hitscan mode builds up charge, alt fire tracking mode gets special scaling Bolt Charge and stack-scaled damage/splash

telesto.name: Telesto
telesto.notes: terrible damage profile, void portal effect requirements are way too steep
telesto.description: sticky, explosive bolts, 3 void or 2 Telesto kills for refill, special reload that makes void rain portal after 3 refills

the colony.name: The Colony
the colony.notes: awful splash per shot, chaining way too slow
the colony.description: seeking spider drones that blow up on enemies, kills spawn 2-6 rank-scaled drones, has ALH equivalent

the jade rabbit.name: The Jade Rabbit
the jade rabbit.notes: even after buffs, high-impact scout that needs more compensation to hold a candle to other meta primaries
the jade rabbit.description: 3 crits or crit kill stack counter, can consume for micro-missile, 2x Firefly damage with stacks, has Shoot to Loot

the last word.name: The Last Word
the last word.notes: only potential relevance is Envious Assassin for LP dump and that is terrible
the last word.description: 88% hipfire crit damage, has Envious Assassin

the manticore.name: The Manticore
the manticore.notes: decent with artifact but airborne mode is very gimmicky and still lacks lethality vs. better void primaries
the manticore.description: grounded hits charge meter, airborne hits consume to ramp up to 2x damage, 15 HP Void OS on airborne kill or 5 elite+ hits

the prospector.name: The Prospector
the prospector.notes: awful total and DPS, bad for add clear too
the prospector.description: shots spawn cluster bombs, has Danger Zone

the queenbreaker.name: The Queenbreaker
the queenbreaker.notes: similar situation to Sleeper, just worse than even other easy Particle options
the queenbreaker.description: either 3 burst higher DPS or precision single shot blind on hit mode, has Rewind Rounds

thorn.name: Thorn

ergo sum.name: Ergo Sum
ergo sum.notes: alternative movement tool, provides sword buff, solid add clear options
ergo sum.description: massive perk diversity, +44% damage while Transcendent, 3 ammo on prismatic grenade hiit

fafnir.name: Fafnir
fafnir.notes: debuff very short, can't debuff immunes, but has ranged advantage over Tractor
fafnir.description: consumes up to 9 ammo for 20s of 5s 30% debuff

izanagi's burden.name: Izanagi's Burden
izanagi's burden.notes: swap option, also decent sustained, still one of the highest no setup crit burst roam options
izanagi's burden.description: special reload sniper that can consume 4 ammo for very high damage shot

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.notes: very good no setup miniboss melt option due to Particle
merciless.description: stacking massively reduced charge time on hits, has 50% damage perk on kill-reload

one thousand voices.name: One Thousand Voices
one thousand voices.notes: extremely easy damage option, arguably not worth it given surrounding alternatives but still decent
one thousand voices.description: delayed scorching explosive bolts, DoT Taken seeker on explosions, 2x tick damage if Witherhoarded

parasite.name: Parasite
parasite.notes: 15% non-power boost is less relevant now, but still has some use cases
parasite.description: 20 stack rank-dependent kill counter, up to 3x damage, self-damage gives 15% damage to other weapons for 10s, has Envious Arsenal

praxic blade.name: Praxic Blade
praxic blade.notes: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal
praxic blade.description: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts

alethonym.name: Alethonym
alethonym.notes: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option
alethonym.description: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups

anarchy.name: Anarchy
anarchy.notes: BiS total tick option for sustained special damage, also good for trapping doors
anarchy.description: 6 linkable stickable traps that tick between them and explode on expiry, has Jolting Feedback and Impromptu Ammunition

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.notes: decent sustained option, decent for roam, has exclusive high 12P variant for melee strategies
bastion.description: pellet fusion that gives +300% melee damage on hits, also has Trench Barrel-esque buff, has Cast No Shadows

d.a.r.c.i..name: D.A.R.C.I.
d.a.r.c.i..notes: nowhere near as beneficial vs. Gjally for rockets, but still useful for large fireteam sniper DPS
d.a.r.c.i..description: shows HP amounts, jolts, and stacks damage buff on long ADS crits, also gives teammates stacking legendary sniper 15.9% buff

edge of action.name: Edge of Action
edge of action.notes: 5% stackable is nice, especially given swap potential, not a bad defensive tool either
edge of action.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire deployable bubble, gives 45 HP Void OS and 5% stackable weapon damage for 10s on dip

euphony.name: Euphony
euphony.notes: good sustained special damage with Pack Tactics
euphony.description: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits

heirloom.name: Heirloom
heirloom.notes: surprisingly excellent splash damage per shot, DoT option for Envious, just has long charge time
heirloom.description: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent

tessellation.name: Tessellation
tessellation.notes: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst
tessellation.description: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect

the fourth horseman.name: The Fourth Horseman
the fourth horseman.notes: very easy instant miniboss burst, usable for damage as well
the fourth horseman.description: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy

turncoat.name: Turncoat
turncoat.notes: usable for roam due to artifact, otherwise situationally useful for extremely optimized rocket dumping
turncoat.description: EP every 3 shots, meter charged on hits/kills, consume to give fire rate, infinite ammo/EP, weaken, transferable stackable buff

wavesplitter.name: Wavesplitter
wavesplitter.notes: probably the best exotic add clear trace in artifact context
wavesplitter.description: cycles power on sustained fire, orb pickup gives max power for 10s and refills, suppresses on 12 max power hits, has AO + Detonator Beam

ager's scepter.name: Ager's Scepter
ager's scepter.notes: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace
ager's scepter.description: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS

arbalest.name: Arbalest
arbalest.notes: completely powercrept stun-wise, useful for guaranteed boss-level shield break
arbalest.description: guaranteed shield break of any type, Disruption Break

buried bloodline.name: Buried Bloodline
buried bloodline.notes: only non-artifact/subclass source of Devour besides RoN 4pc. for challenges
buried bloodline.description: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour

collective obligation.name: Collective Obligation
collective obligation.description: stores void debuffs from targets or makes them every 27 hits, alt fire to apply debuffs and +20% damage, refill on void buffs, has Repulsor Brace

cull's shadow.name: Cull's Shadow
cull's shadow.notes: tick option for Envious, melee stacking neutral is decent
cull's shadow.description: aggressive fusion with blades that take melee buffs, applies DoT via shots after 2 melees, ticked enemies make crystals on death

delicate tomb.name: Delicate Tomb
delicate tomb.notes: better instant Ionic Trace source than Coldheart, worse ammo economy though
delicate tomb.description: 16 bolt burst, 20% damage on hipfire, Ionic Trace chance on kill (guaranteed if elite+), 2x damage jolting shot and 4 ammo refill on trace pickup

dragon's breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragon's breath.notes: underrated swap DPS option, has unique Firesprite bypass use case
dragon's breath.description: refills on 2 ignitions, damage and longer embed based on stacks, spawns Firesprites on kill and bypasses cooldown

finality's auger.name: Finality's Auger
finality's auger.notes: outclassed by Anarchy, better super generation but not relevant any more, can be placed inside doors
finality's auger.description: alt fire deployable turret that can paint targets to deal more damage, has regular LFR mode, has Bait and Switch

graviton lance.name: Graviton Lance
graviton lance.notes: pretty strong with artiifact, more lethal but less debuff-focused Collective Obligation competitor
graviton lance.description: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout

ice breaker.name: Ice Breaker
ice breaker.notes: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds
ice breaker.description: custom sniper frame, generates ammo from non-Ice Breaker kills or stasis-debuffed hits, ignition on crit or frozen shatter

khvostov 7g-0x.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
khvostov 7g-0x.notes: great for contest-like environments for spreading assist credit and getting ammo, also generally potent in solos
khvostov 7g-0x.description: ricocheting auto, orbs give 7 enhanced ricocheting bullets that bounce 7 times, has Shoot to Loot + Attrition Orbs

legend of acrius.name: Legend of Acrius
legend of acrius.notes: simple and consistent melee damage option, similar to high tier swords
legend of acrius.description: massive spread overpenetrating pellets, has a grounded damage instance, has Trench Barrel

necrochasm.name: Necrochasm
necrochasm.notes: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong
necrochasm.description: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant

new malpais.name: New Malpais
new malpais.notes: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously
new malpais.description: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation

prometheus lens.name: Prometheus Lens
prometheus lens.notes: besides unique ammo gen, certainly not the strongest exotic add clear trace
prometheus lens.description: scorching field on sustained damage, 75 ammo refill on kill, has Incandescent

salvation's grip.name: Salvation's Grip
salvation's grip.notes: only useful for DSM and terrain generation requirements in challenges
salvation's grip.description: charged shots shoot crystal formation, uncharged shots break crystals, 25% damage to frozen enemies, has Rimestealer

the lament.name: The Lament
the lament.notes: higher QoL but worse damage version of Wolfsbane
the lament.description: 7HP on damage tick (includes scorch), special blocking revving mechanic that amps damage, has Burning Ambition

the navigator.name: The Navigator
the navigator.notes: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)
the navigator.description: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload

trinity ghoul.name: Trinity Ghoul
trinity ghoul.notes: scales very poorly into low power content, but still has some use for easy spread chained add clear
trinity ghoul.description: 3 split arrows, arc kills give next shot chain lightning

vex mythoclast.name: Vex Mythoclast
vex mythoclast.notes: easily best single target primary ever produced in sandbox context, but niche in endgame is still small
vex mythoclast.description: fusion interactions, 6 kills (T3+ doubled) for crit kill igniting LFR mode, 20% damage for 5s on sustained fire or kill, has Rewind Rounds variant

vexcalibur.name: Vexcalibur
vexcalibur.notes: underrated, probably best purely defensive exotic, just struggles to activate overshield refresh in low power
vexcalibur.description: special 5 bolt spread, +25% projectile damage to Vex, blocking gives Void OS to allies within 15m, glaive melee kills give full OS while OS is active

whirling ovation.name: Whirling Ovation
whirling ovation.notes: already struggled to differentiate itself from Parasite during rocket pulse meta, maybe useful for some optimized finals
whirling ovation.description: time-scaled strand/solar damage that charges faster as damage is done with other weapons, solar grenade on minor/elite pierce

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
wolfsbane.notes: most relevant melee range easy sustained damage option
wolfsbane.description: charges meter on hits and kills, can consume to activate overclocked mode with scorching cyclones, has variable catalysts

bad juju.name: Bad Juju
bad juju.notes: super generation niche surpassed by artifact setup, add clear profile underrated though
bad juju.description: hugely increased super generation on stacking kill perk, also has cursed thrall explosion on 3 kills

cerberus+1.name: Cerberus+1
cerberus+1.notes: basically just for breaking crystals and maybe Calus skulls
cerberus+1.description: pellet auto with 50% damage perk on special kill-reload

cloudstrike.name: Cloudstrike
cloudstrike.notes: outclassed by legendary snipers, lightning strike is used in just RoN 3rd
cloudstrike.description: Bolt Charge (x5 on kill) and lightning strike on 3 crits or crit kill, has Triple Tap

coldheart.name: Coldheart
coldheart.notes: best sustained Ionic Trace source in the game, however not the most applicable use case
coldheart.description: sustained damage and Ionic Traces give energy, spawns Ionic Trace every 2s at max energy, has Supercharged Magazine

conditional finality.name: Conditional Finality
conditional finality.notes: good chunks and high QoL for roam, but no crazy outlier behavior for endgame
conditional finality.description: stasis/solar 2 mag shotgun that freezes and ignites with respective shots

duality.name: Duality
duality.notes: very solid sustained DPS for a special but nothing standout
duality.description: pellet kill or most pellets hit stack 3x up to 54.7% slug crit damage for 10.5s, slug crits refresh duration

eriana's vow.name: Eriana's Vow
eriana's vow.notes: good for killing individual potentially shielded enemies, otherwise useless
eriana's vow.description: 32.5% damage on first scoped shot, buff disappears after body shot, ignition on matching or champion shield break, has ALH

ex diris.name: Ex Diris
ex diris.notes: weapon-based Amplified, can be used to die, add clear and damage aren't good
ex diris.description: scaling fire rate increase on hits (maxed on crit health), spawns moth on 2 hits (3s ICD), Amplified on kill

eyes of tomorrow.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
eyes of tomorrow.notes: slow but technically has infinite ammo power-level add clear
eyes of tomorrow.description: 6 individually tracking rockets, 4 kills with one volley gives 50% damage buff and 1 ammo refund, has Demolitionist and Blast Distributor

fighting lion.name: Fighting Lion
fighting lion.notes: usable for certain builds due to artifact (void/Weakened Clear)
fighting lion.description: volatile burst on hit, refill on non-Fighting Lion kill within 6s of dealing damage

final warning.name: Final Warning
final warning.notes: in theory a strong damage profile but a little unwieldy to use
final warning.description: tracking/hitscan hybrid sidearm that can mark enemies to do 2x crit damage and fully charge to unravel

forerunner.name: Forerunner
forerunner.notes: The Rock has crazy scaling with grenade buffs but otherwise not relevant for add clear
forerunner.description: insane crit multi special sidearm, has special kill-reload that replaces grenade with frag that scales with grenade buffs

grand overture.name: Grand Overture
grand overture.notes: outdated damage, total not even that impressive, too slow for add clear
grand overture.description: slug launcher that loads up to 20 blinding missiles on hit that explode on kill, alt fire to change modes and fire missile burst

heartshadow.name: Heartshadow
heartshadow.notes: niche debuff extension option for sword damage, otherwise not very useful
heartshadow.description: weaken on hit, 25% damage, and move speed while invisible, invisibility on grounded powered heavy

le monarque.name: Le Monarque
le monarque.notes: only notable due to Storm's Keep interaction
le monarque.description: fully drawn crits leave fast ticking poison, has Unrelenting

lord of wolves.name: Lord of Wolves
lord of wolves.notes: completely outclassed by both legendary and exotic special alternatives, unique ammo gen stat
lord of wolves.description: 5 shot bursts, hipfire causes scorching shots, ADS causes scorching explosion on kill

lumina.name: Lumina
lumina.notes: grappling eclipsed by Alethonym and rockets, damage buff succeeded by Boots of the Assembler
lumina.description: 2 Noble Rounds on kill, hipfire to give 35% damage buff and 100 Class to wielder and ally for 11s

microcosm.name: Microcosm
microcosm.notes: shield health use case is extremely rare and Arbalest exists, damage profile is awful
microcosm.description: huge bonus to shields, refill and 20% damage for 20s on super, has Thresh and rank-dependent buffed super gains

monte carlo.name: Monte Carlo
monte carlo.notes: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics
monte carlo.description: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet

new land beyond.name: New Land Beyond
new land beyond.notes: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche
new land beyond.description: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks

osteo striga.name: Osteo Striga
osteo striga.notes: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too
osteo striga.description: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag

rat king.name: Rat King
rat king.notes: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad
rat king.description: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King

red death reformed.name: Red Death Reformed
red death reformed.notes: held back by frame, great survivability but poor lethality, doesn't really fit current endgame playstyle
red death reformed.description: Cure x2 on kill, Cure x1 to allies on kill-reload, scaling damage as HP gets lower, healing orb on 3 weapon kill counter

riskrunner.name: Riskrunner
riskrunner.notes: Arc shield is sometimes useful for certain solos, otherwise Arc Conductor trigger requirement too situational
riskrunner.description: 50% arc resist and chain lightning on incoming arc damage, has Chain Reaction

service of luzaku.name: Service of Luzaku
service of luzaku.notes: only relic droppable interact, otherwise waste of exotic heavy slot
service of luzaku.description: support frame mechanics, threadling-spawning nests on kills, can be healed, harvestable after 6 threadlings spawned

skyburner's oath.name: Skyburner's Oath
skyburner's oath.notes: solid laid-back ignition spam option, but very slow playstyle
skyburner's oath.description: scorching hipfire projectiles, has Incandescent and Burning Ambition, +11% damage to Cabal

slayer's fang.name: Slayer's Fang
slayer's fang.notes: can be used for add clear due to ammo economy changes, decent artifact synergy, just lacks range
slayer's fang.description: bouncing submunition shots, 15% crit damage, weaken, and partial refill on kill or Void Breach pickup, +10% damage to Fallen/Scorn

sleeper simulant.name: Sleeper Simulant
sleeper simulant.notes: completely outclassed by plenty of other easy damage options
sleeper simulant.description: overpenetrating low crit multi shots that split into 5 reflecting lasers

sunshot.name: Sunshot
sunshot.notes: slight range issues compared to better exotic primaries, little to no artifact synergy, less consistent in lower power
sunshot.description: explosive HC with low scorch high damage explosion on kill, has Loose Change

tarrabah.name: Tarrabah
tarrabah.notes: Ravenous Beast buffs provide high uptime and unique niche, high ammo gen too
tarrabah.description: stores damage instances, then consumes for ~2x damage and fire rate buff with 50% solar resist, has Ambitious Assassin

the chaperone.name: The Chaperone
the chaperone.notes: very easy shotgun spam damage, worse than all optimized specials though
the chaperone.description: rapid slug with 22% damage and fire rate buff on 2 crits or 1 crit kill, has Triple Tap

the huckleberry.name: The Huckleberry
the huckleberry.notes: one of the best 100 ammo gen weapons, unfortuantely definitely lacking in lethality vs. better primaries
the huckleberry.description: ramping fire rate SMG with 3 kill counter 66% damage perk and Kinetic Tremors

the wardcliff coil.name: The Wardcliff Coil
the wardcliff coil.notes: still has small niche for non-boss classed bosses, otherwise useless
the wardcliff coil.description: 8 scattered tracking mini rockets, Bolt Charge every 2 rockets, refills on heavy pickup

third iteration.name: Third Iteration
third iteration.notes: gameplay loop way too slow despite being void, can be used for tormentors in challenges but very small niche
third iteration.description: spread projectiles, condensed round that marks after ADS time, marked targets take +95% spread shot damage

thunderlord.name: Thunderlord
thunderlord.notes: terrible for boss DPS, outclassed for roam by abilities and weapons galore
thunderlord.description: ramping fire rate, lightning strike every 10 hits or kill that refills 5 ammo and gives Bolt Charge

traveler's chosen.name: Traveler's Chosen
traveler's chosen.notes: only niche is regenerating abilities post-swap, but still requires 10 kills
traveler's chosen.description: 10 stack kill counter, consume to get 10% of every ability per stack, has Osmosis

verglas curve.name: Verglas Curve
verglas curve.notes: used for making hiding spot crystals in challenges and line spots in speedruns, otherwise very slow neutral
verglas curve.description: 5 stack kill counter that makes freezing crystal shots on hipfire, size scales with stacks, +50% damage to frozen enemies

whisper of the worm.name: Whisper of the Worm
whisper of the worm.notes: completely outclassed by all sorts of linears and snipers
whisper of the worm.description: 35% crit damage on long ADS shots, has Triple Tap with full mag refill

winterbite.name: Winterbite
winterbite.notes: technically has some sort of sustain loop with Rimestealer but other glaives are likely better for melee builds
winterbite.description: slow orb that freezes and explodes on impact, increased damage slowing melees, has Rimestealer

wish-ender.name: Wish-Ender
wish-ender.notes: slow draw time on an already low uptime archetype, damage isn't special and no splash effect
wish-ender.description: overpenetrating 3 instance shots, Truesight on ADS, +25% against Witherhoarded enemies, +10% to Taken enemies, has One for All

witherhoard.name: Witherhoard
witherhoard.notes: basically just used for Envious DoT
witherhoard.description: projectile either sticks enemies and applies DoT or creates blight pool on ground, has buffed ALH

worldline zero.name: Worldline Zero
worldline zero.notes: occasionally used for Blade Focus purposes in speedrunning, otherwise basically useless
worldline zero.description: special heavy blink mode that chains on kills after 1s of sprinting

xenophage.name: Xenophage
xenophage.notes: Oracles encounter one trick, not used for anything else
xenophage.description: slow-firing explosive rounds, has Chain Reaction and Rampage

ace of spades.name: Ace of Spades
ace of spades.notes: mathematically better than a good legendary kinetic 140 but not by much
ace of spades.description: standard 140 HC with buffed Firefly and 68% damage for 6 shots on kill-reload

barrow-dyad.name: Barrow-Dyad
barrow-dyad.notes: no special synergies, PKs niche is gone, nothing worth exotic slot
barrow-dyad.description: refilling SMG that stores blight into 6 high-damage seekers upon doing normal damage

black talon.name: Black Talon
black talon.notes: awful damage profile for boss DPS, roam has little use besides suppression source
black talon.description: ranged double cast suppressing void slash heavy attacks, splashes suppress on slash kills

borealis.name: Borealis
borealis.notes: high damage per shot with Ionic Return but really never worth using
borealis.description: element-swappable, matched effect gives 30% damage for 10s, matching shield break gives 37% crit shot, has Shield Disorient

centrifuse.name: Centrifuse
centrifuse.notes: movement gimmick is annoying, likely overshadowed by legendary arc autos
centrifuse.description: sprinting refills, movement and shooting build charge, kills have charge-scaled explosion damage/radius, no decay while Amplified

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.notes: high ammo gen but extremely outdated kit and LP stacking not relevant any more
crimson.description: 3-burst HC that gives 32 HP and starts regen on kill, refills on crit kill

cryosthesia 77k.name: Cryosthesia 77K
cryosthesia 77k.notes: freeze shot no longer relevant for challenges given prominence of freeze options
cryosthesia 77k.description: freezing shot on special kill-reload, refill on frozen kill

dead man's tale.name: Dead Man's Tale
dead man's tale.notes: held back by frame, single target nature, not that special
dead man's tale.description: aggressive scout that has up to 17% damage perk, 27% hipfire damage, and hipfire rate on crits

deathbringer.name: Deathbringer
deathbringer.notes: outclassed in boss DPS and for add clear
deathbringer.description: slow void orb that splits into 7 falling tracking projectiles, damage scales off travel time

deterministic chaos.name: Deterministic Chaos
deterministic chaos.notes: not worth using over legendary void LMG, debuff extension just worse than Withering or Fafnir
deterministic chaos.description: volatile every 4th shot, weaken every 32nd shot (bugged), refills 12 ammo on weaken shot release, has Target Lock

devil's ruin.name: Devil's Ruin
devil's ruin.notes: no CD bypass like Dragon's Breath, not as consistently lethal as better exotic primaries
devil's ruin.description: Firesprite on kill, high damage scorching charged laser on special reload after Firesprite pickup, has Collective Action

edge of concurrence.name: Edge of Concurrence
edge of concurrence.notes: seeker does a lot of damage but uptime is way too low
edge of concurrence.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire jolting chaining lightning seeker

edge of intent.name: Edge of Intent
edge of intent.notes: more useful than Concurrence but uptime is surprisingly not that great
edge of intent.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire 9s healing turret that gives Cure and Restoration to allies every 3s, ToF gives x2 to recipient

graviton spike.name: Graviton Spike
graviton spike.notes: cool concept and on-hit splash is good, unfortunately still too slow for endgame standards
graviton spike.description: alt fire toggleable arc lightning strike or stasis crystal spawner modes, overcharge other mode every 3 crits, 20% damage for overcharging both

hard light.name: Hard Light
hard light.notes: can be used for specific lineups to start encounters, otherwise basically useless
hard light.description: element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage, double ricochet, ricocheted bullets do 2x damage, has Light Touch

hawkmoon.name: Hawkmoon
hawkmoon.notes: similar situation to Dead Man's Tale
hawkmoon.description: crit stacking damage HC with high damage final round based on stacks

heir apparent.name: Heir Apparent
heir apparent.notes: arc shield melts quickly in endgame content, damage is terrible
heir apparent.description: 1.5s spin-up period, creates 75% DR 80 HP arc donut shield if at full HP after ramping, refills half of mag when shield is destroyed

jötunn.name: Jötunn
jötunn.notes: awful damage profile, terrible add clear, slow pace
jötunn.description: tracking explosive projectile that leaves burning spot, has Cornered and Incandescent

lodestar.name: Lodestar
lodestar.notes: struggles against legendary traces with Harsh Refraction, not remarkable besides primary status
lodestar.description: either hipfire normal trace or ADS pulse mode that explodes on arc-debuffed kills, jolt on hit mode after charging meter via arc hits

lorentz driver.name: Lorentz Driver
lorentz driver.notes: marking gimmick is very slow tempo vs. current pace of endgame field, also not even that potent
lorentz driver.description: implosion on crit kill, marked targets spawn telemetries on death, 6 ammo, 50% damage, and body shot implosions for 30s on 3 pickups

malfeasance.name: Malfeasance
malfeasance.notes: LP use case is long gone, damage profile is mediocre, no synergy
malfeasance.description: explosion on 5 hits, +25% to Taken and +25% to Witherhoarded enemies

mida multi-tool.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
mida multi-tool.notes: awful damage profile, has some utility for move speed boosts with relics
mida multi-tool.description: +12.5% move speed, 4-tier buff that stacks on MIDA kills, scales to +14.4% damage and explosive shots

no time to explain.name: No Time to Explain
no time to explain.notes: terrible damage profile and dated add clear effect
no time to explain.description: 10 crits or stasis-debuffed hits spawn buddy turret

outbreak perfected.name: Outbreak Perfected
outbreak perfected.notes: very slow exotic effect, awful for damage, super generation is nuked
outbreak perfected.description: 12 crits spawn nanites, eventually scaling to 4x damage, nanite swarm spawned on kills

polaris lance.name: Polaris Lance
polaris lance.notes: gameplay loop too slow for endgame viability
polaris lance.description: scorching solar round after 4 crits, refunds shot if crit, has Dragonfly

quicksilver storm.name: Quicksilver Storm
quicksilver storm.notes: on-hit stacking effect is way too slow for current exotic weapon field
quicksilver storm.description: Nanotech Tracer Missiles version, landing hits eventually loads special reload grenade that makes tangle on kill

revision zero.name: Revision Zero
revision zero.notes: strong single target, Hunter's Trace shots do a lot, but doesn't find a niche
revision zero.description: meter filled on crits, consumed to give sniper shots that spawn kinetic shockwaves, has FTTC

ruinous effigy.name: Ruinous Effigy
ruinous effigy.notes: actually decent with artifact support but Wavesplitter is just better
ruinous effigy.description: damage field slammable relic dropped on kill, 30% damage for 7s on relic kill or miniboss+ relic damage

sturm.name: Sturm
sturm.notes: very unremarkable exotic effect, purely single target
sturm.description: energy weapon refill on kill, Together Forever kills load overcharged rounds (more on multikills) that do up to 4x damage

suros regime.name: SUROS Regime
suros regime.notes: purely single target, ammo effect is not nearly good enough
suros regime.description: either stable fire rate + extra heavy progress or ramping fire rate + extra special progress, has modified HIR and 50% chance to heal on kill

sweet business.name: Sweet Business
sweet business.notes: terrible minor DPS even when ramped, nothing else special
sweet business.description: ramping fire rate and massive mag, occasional explosive round, refill on brick pickup

symmetry.name: Symmetry
symmetry.notes: has unique interaction with scalable Bolt Charge, but still insanely slow tempo weapon
symmetry.description: hitscan mode builds up charge, alt fire tracking mode gets special scaling Bolt Charge and stack-scaled damage/splash

telesto.name: Telesto
telesto.notes: terrible damage profile, void portal effect requirements are way too steep
telesto.description: sticky, explosive bolts, 3 void or 2 Telesto kills for refill, special reload that makes void rain portal after 3 refills

the colony.name: The Colony
the colony.notes: awful splash per shot, chaining way too slow
the colony.description: seeking spider drones that blow up on enemies, kills spawn 2-6 rank-scaled drones, has ALH equivalent

the jade rabbit.name: The Jade Rabbit
the jade rabbit.notes: even after buffs, high-impact scout that needs more compensation to hold a candle to other meta primaries
