Exotic Weapons.description: pellet fusion that gives +300% melee damage on hits, also has Trench Barrel-esque buff, has Cast No Shadows

Exotic Weapons.name: D.A.R.C.I.
Exotic Weapons.notes: nowhere near as beneficial vs. Gjally for rockets, but still useful for large fireteam sniper DPS
Exotic Weapons.description: shows HP amounts, jolts, and stacks damage buff on long ADS crits, also gives teammates stacking legendary sniper 15.9% buff

Exotic Weapons.name: Edge of Action
Exotic Weapons.notes: 5% stackable is nice, especially given swap potential, not a bad defensive tool either
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire deployable bubble, gives 45 HP Void OS and 5% stackable weapon damage for 10s on dip

Exotic Weapons.name: Euphony
Exotic Weapons.notes: good sustained special damage with Pack Tactics
Exotic Weapons.description: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits

Exotic Weapons.name: Heirloom
Exotic Weapons.notes: surprisingly excellent splash damage per shot, DoT option for Envious, just has long charge time
Exotic Weapons.description: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent

Exotic Weapons.name: Tessellation
Exotic Weapons.notes: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst
Exotic Weapons.description: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect

Exotic Weapons.name: The Fourth Horseman
Exotic Weapons.notes: very easy instant miniboss burst, usable for damage as well
Exotic Weapons.description: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy

Exotic Weapons.name: Turncoat
Exotic Weapons.notes: usable for roam due to artifact, otherwise situationally useful for extremely optimized rocket dumping
Exotic Weapons.description: EP every 3 shots, meter charged on hits/kills, consume to give fire rate, infinite ammo/EP, weaken, transferable stackable buff

Exotic Weapons.name: Wavesplitter
Exotic Weapons.notes: probably the best exotic add clear trace in artifact context
Exotic Weapons.description: cycles power on sustained fire, orb pickup gives max power for 10s and refills, suppresses on 12 max power hits, has AO + Detonator Beam

Exotic Weapons.name: Ager's Scepter
Exotic Weapons.notes: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace
Exotic Weapons.description: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS

Exotic Weapons.name: Arbalest
Exotic Weapons.notes: completely powercrept stun-wise, useful for guaranteed boss-level shield break
Exotic Weapons.description: guaranteed shield break of any type, Disruption Break

Exotic Weapons.name: Buried Bloodline
Exotic Weapons.notes: only non-artifact/subclass source of Devour besides RoN 4pc. for challenges
Exotic Weapons.description: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour

Exotic Weapons.name: Collective Obligation
Exotic Weapons.notes: excellent with void artifact
Exotic Weapons.description: stores void debuffs from targets or makes them every 27 hits, alt fire to apply debuffs and +20% damage, refill on void buffs, has Repulsor Brace

Exotic Weapons.name: Cull's Shadow
Exotic Weapons.notes: tick option for Envious, melee stacking neutral is decent
Exotic Weapons.description: aggressive fusion with blades that take melee buffs, applies DoT via shots after 2 melees, ticked enemies make crystals on death

Exotic Weapons.name: Delicate Tomb
Exotic Weapons.notes: better instant Ionic Trace source than Coldheart, worse ammo economy though
Exotic Weapons.description: 16 bolt burst, 20% damage on hipfire, Ionic Trace chance on kill (guaranteed if elite+), 2x damage jolting shot and 4 ammo refill on trace pickup

Exotic Weapons.name: Dragon's Breath
Exotic Weapons.notes: underrated swap DPS option, has unique Firesprite bypass use case
Exotic Weapons.description: refills on 2 ignitions, damage and longer embed based on stacks, spawns Firesprites on kill and bypasses cooldown

Exotic Weapons.name: Finality's Auger
Exotic Weapons.notes: outclassed by Anarchy, better super generation but not relevant any more, can be placed inside doors
Exotic Weapons.description: alt fire deployable turret that can paint targets to deal more damage, has regular LFR mode, has Bait and Switch

Exotic Weapons.name: Graviton Lance
Exotic Weapons.notes: pretty strong with artiifact, more lethal but less debuff-focused Collective Obligation competitor
Exotic Weapons.description: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout

Exotic Weapons.name: Ice Breaker
Exotic Weapons.notes: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds
Exotic Weapons.description: custom sniper frame, generates ammo from non-Ice Breaker kills or stasis-debuffed hits, ignition on crit or frozen shatter

Exotic Weapons.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
Exotic Weapons.notes: great for contest-like environments for spreading assist credit and getting ammo, also generally potent in solos
Exotic Weapons.description: ricocheting auto, orbs give 7 enhanced ricocheting bullets that bounce 7 times, has Shoot to Loot + Attrition Orbs

Exotic Weapons.name: Legend of Acrius
Exotic Weapons.notes: simple and consistent melee damage option, similar to high tier swords
Exotic Weapons.description: massive spread overpenetrating pellets, has a grounded damage instance, has Trench Barrel

Exotic Weapons.name: Necrochasm
Exotic Weapons.notes: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong
Exotic Weapons.description: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant

Exotic Weapons.name: New Malpais
Exotic Weapons.notes: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation

Exotic Weapons.name: Prometheus Lens
Exotic Weapons.notes: besides unique ammo gen, certainly not the strongest exotic add clear trace
Exotic Weapons.description: scorching field on sustained damage, 75 ammo refill on kill, has Incandescent

Exotic Weapons.name: Salvation's Grip
Exotic Weapons.notes: only useful for DSM and terrain generation requirements in challenges
Exotic Weapons.description: charged shots shoot crystal formation, uncharged shots break crystals, 25% damage to frozen enemies, has Rimestealer

Exotic Weapons.name: The Lament
Exotic Weapons.notes: higher QoL but worse damage version of Wolfsbane
Exotic Weapons.description: 7HP on damage tick (includes scorch), special blocking revving mechanic that amps damage, has Burning Ambition

Exotic Weapons.name: The Navigator
Exotic Weapons.notes: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)
Exotic Weapons.description: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload

Exotic Weapons.name: Trinity Ghoul
Exotic Weapons.notes: scales very poorly into low power content, but still has some use for easy spread chained add clear
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 split arrows, arc kills give next shot chain lightning

Exotic Weapons.name: Vex Mythoclast
Exotic Weapons.notes: easily best single target primary ever produced in sandbox context, but niche in endgame is still small
Exotic Weapons.description: fusion interactions, 6 kills (T3+ doubled) for crit kill igniting LFR mode, 20% damage for 5s on sustained fire or kill, has Rewind Rounds variant

Exotic Weapons.name: Vexcalibur
Exotic Weapons.notes: underrated, probably best purely defensive exotic, just struggles to activate overshield refresh in low power
Exotic Weapons.description: special 5 bolt spread, +25% projectile damage to Vex, blocking gives Void OS to allies within 15m, glaive melee kills give full OS while OS is active

Exotic Weapons.name: Whirling Ovation
Exotic Weapons.notes: already struggled to differentiate itself from Parasite during rocket pulse meta, maybe useful for some optimized finals
Exotic Weapons.description: time-scaled strand/solar damage that charges faster as damage is done with other weapons, solar grenade on minor/elite pierce

Exotic Weapons.name: Wolfsbane
Exotic Weapons.notes: most relevant melee range easy sustained damage option
Exotic Weapons.description: charges meter on hits and kills, can consume to activate overclocked mode with scorching cyclones, has variable catalysts

Exotic Weapons.name: Bad Juju
Exotic Weapons.notes: super generation niche surpassed by artifact setup, add clear profile underrated though
Exotic Weapons.description: hugely increased super generation on stacking kill perk, also has cursed thrall explosion on 3 kills

Exotic Weapons.name: Cerberus+1
Exotic Weapons.notes: basically just for breaking crystals and maybe Calus skulls
Exotic Weapons.description: pellet auto with 50% damage perk on special kill-reload

Exotic Weapons.name: Cloudstrike
Exotic Weapons.notes: outclassed by legendary snipers, lightning strike is used in just RoN 3rd
Exotic Weapons.description: Bolt Charge (x5 on kill) and lightning strike on 3 crits or crit kill, has Triple Tap

Exotic Weapons.name: Coldheart
Exotic Weapons.notes: best sustained Ionic Trace source in the game, however not the most applicable use case
Exotic Weapons.description: sustained damage and Ionic Traces give energy, spawns Ionic Trace every 2s at max energy, has Supercharged Magazine

Exotic Weapons.name: Conditional Finality
Exotic Weapons.notes: good chunks and high QoL for roam, but no crazy outlier behavior for endgame
Exotic Weapons.description: stasis/solar 2 mag shotgun that freezes and ignites with respective shots

Exotic Weapons.name: Duality
Exotic Weapons.notes: very solid sustained DPS for a special but nothing standout
Exotic Weapons.description: pellet kill or most pellets hit stack 3x up to 54.7% slug crit damage for 10.5s, slug crits refresh duration

Exotic Weapons.name: Eriana's Vow
Exotic Weapons.notes: good for killing individual potentially shielded enemies, otherwise useless
Exotic Weapons.description: 32.5% damage on first scoped shot, buff disappears after body shot, ignition on matching or champion shield break, has ALH

Exotic Weapons.name: Ex Diris
Exotic Weapons.notes: weapon-based Amplified, can be used to die, add clear and damage aren't good
Exotic Weapons.description: scaling fire rate increase on hits (maxed on crit health), spawns moth on 2 hits (3s ICD), Amplified on kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
Exotic Weapons.notes: slow but technically has infinite ammo power-level add clear
Exotic Weapons.description: 6 individually tracking rockets, 4 kills with one volley gives 50% damage buff and 1 ammo refund, has Demolitionist and Blast Distributor

Exotic Weapons.name: Fighting Lion
Exotic Weapons.notes: usable for certain builds due to artifact (void/Weakened Clear)
Exotic Weapons.description: volatile burst on hit, refill on non-Fighting Lion kill within 6s of dealing damage

Exotic Weapons.name: Final Warning
Exotic Weapons.notes: in theory a strong damage profile but a little unwieldy to use
Exotic Weapons.description: tracking/hitscan hybrid sidearm that can mark enemies to do 2x crit damage and fully charge to unravel

Exotic Weapons.name: Forerunner
Exotic Weapons.notes: The Rock has crazy scaling with grenade buffs but otherwise not relevant for add clear
Exotic Weapons.description: insane crit multi special sidearm, has special kill-reload that replaces grenade with frag that scales with grenade buffs

Exotic Weapons.name: Grand Overture
Exotic Weapons.notes: outdated damage, total not even that impressive, too slow for add clear
Exotic Weapons.description: slug launcher that loads up to 20 blinding missiles on hit that explode on kill, alt fire to change modes and fire missile burst

Exotic Weapons.name: Heartshadow
Exotic Weapons.notes: niche debuff extension option for sword damage, otherwise not very useful
Exotic Weapons.description: weaken on hit, 25% damage, and move speed while invisible, invisibility on grounded powered heavy

Exotic Weapons.name: Le Monarque
Exotic Weapons.notes: only notable due to Storm's Keep interaction
Exotic Weapons.description: fully drawn crits leave fast ticking poison, has Unrelenting

Exotic Weapons.name: Lord of Wolves
Exotic Weapons.notes: completely outclassed by both legendary and exotic special alternatives, unique ammo gen stat
Exotic Weapons.description: 5 shot bursts, hipfire causes scorching shots, ADS causes scorching explosion on kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Lumina
Exotic Weapons.notes: grappling eclipsed by Alethonym and rockets, damage buff succeeded by Boots of the Assembler
Exotic Weapons.description: 2 Noble Rounds on kill, hipfire to give 35% damage buff and 100 Class to wielder and ally for 11s

Exotic Weapons.name: Microcosm
Exotic Weapons.notes: shield health use case is extremely rare and Arbalest exists, damage profile is awful
Exotic Weapons.description: huge bonus to shields, refill and 20% damage for 20s on super, has Thresh and rank-dependent buffed super gains

Exotic Weapons.name: Monte Carlo
Exotic Weapons.notes: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics
Exotic Weapons.description: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet

Exotic Weapons.name: New Land Beyond
Exotic Weapons.notes: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche
Exotic Weapons.description: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks

Exotic Weapons.name: Osteo Striga
Exotic Weapons.notes: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too
Exotic Weapons.description: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag

Exotic Weapons.name: Rat King
Exotic Weapons.notes: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad
Exotic Weapons.description: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King

Exotic Weapons.name: Red Death Reformed
Exotic Weapons.notes: held back by frame, great survivability but poor lethality, doesn't really fit current endgame playstyle
Exotic Weapons.description: Cure x2 on kill, Cure x1 to allies on kill-reload, scaling damage as HP gets lower, healing orb on 3 weapon kill counter

Exotic Weapons.name: Riskrunner
Exotic Weapons.notes: Arc shield is sometimes useful for certain solos, otherwise Arc Conductor trigger requirement too situational
Exotic Weapons.description: 50% arc resist and chain lightning on incoming arc damage, has Chain Reaction

Exotic Weapons.name: Service of Luzaku
Exotic Weapons.notes: only relic droppable interact, otherwise waste of exotic heavy slot
Exotic Weapons.description: support frame mechanics, threadling-spawning nests on kills, can be healed, harvestable after 6 threadlings spawned

Exotic Weapons.name: Skyburner's Oath
Exotic Weapons.notes: solid laid-back ignition spam option, but very slow playstyle
Exotic Weapons.description: scorching hipfire projectiles, has Incandescent and Burning Ambition, +11% damage to Cabal

Exotic Weapons.name: Slayer's Fang
Exotic Weapons.notes: can be used for add clear due to ammo economy changes, decent artifact synergy, just lacks range
Exotic Weapons.description: bouncing submunition shots, 15% crit damage, weaken, and partial refill on kill or Void Breach pickup, +10% damage to Fallen/Scorn

Exotic Weapons.name: Sleeper Simulant
Exotic Weapons.notes: completely outclassed by plenty of other easy damage options
Exotic Weapons.description: overpenetrating low crit multi shots that split into 5 reflecting lasers

Exotic Weapons.name: Sunshot
Exotic Weapons.notes: slight range issues compared to better exotic primaries, little to no artifact synergy, less consistent in lower power
Exotic Weapons.description: explosive HC with low scorch high damage explosion on kill, has Loose Change

Exotic Weapons.name: Tarrabah
Exotic Weapons.notes: Ravenous Beast buffs provide high uptime and unique niche, high ammo gen too
Exotic Weapons.description: stores damage instances, then consumes for ~2x damage and fire rate buff with 50% solar resist, has Ambitious Assassin

Exotic Weapons.name: The Chaperone
Exotic Weapons.notes: very easy shotgun spam damage, worse than all optimized specials though
Exotic Weapons.description: rapid slug with 22% damage and fire rate buff on 2 crits or 1 crit kill, has Triple Tap

Exotic Weapons.name: The Huckleberry
Exotic Weapons.notes: one of the best 100 ammo gen weapons, unfortuantely definitely lacking in lethality vs. better primaries
Exotic Weapons.description: ramping fire rate SMG with 3 kill counter 66% damage perk and Kinetic Tremors

Exotic Weapons.name: The Wardcliff Coil
Exotic Weapons.notes: still has small niche for non-boss classed bosses, otherwise useless
Exotic Weapons.description: 8 scattered tracking mini rockets, Bolt Charge every 2 rockets, refills on heavy pickup

Exotic Weapons.name: Third Iteration
Exotic Weapons.notes: gameplay loop way too slow despite being void, can be used for tormentors in challenges but very small niche
Exotic Weapons.description: spread projectiles, condensed round that marks after ADS time, marked targets take +95% spread shot damage

Exotic Weapons.name: Thunderlord
Exotic Weapons.notes: terrible for boss DPS, outclassed for roam by abilities and weapons galore
Exotic Weapons.description: ramping fire rate, lightning strike every 10 hits or kill that refills 5 ammo and gives Bolt Charge

Exotic Weapons.name: Traveler's Chosen
Exotic Weapons.notes: only niche is regenerating abilities post-swap, but still requires 10 kills
Exotic Weapons.description: 10 stack kill counter, consume to get 10% of every ability per stack, has Osmosis

Exotic Weapons.name: Verglas Curve
Exotic Weapons.notes: used for making hiding spot crystals in challenges and line spots in speedruns, otherwise very slow neutral
Exotic Weapons.description: 5 stack kill counter that makes freezing crystal shots on hipfire, size scales with stacks, +50% damage to frozen enemies

Exotic Weapons.name: Whisper of the Worm
Exotic Weapons.notes: completely outclassed by all sorts of linears and snipers
Exotic Weapons.description: 35% crit damage on long ADS shots, has Triple Tap with full mag refill

Exotic Weapons.name: Winterbite
Exotic Weapons.notes: technically has some sort of sustain loop with Rimestealer but other glaives are likely better for melee builds
Exotic Weapons.description: slow orb that freezes and explodes on impact, increased damage slowing melees, has Rimestealer

Exotic Weapons.name: Wish-Ender
Exotic Weapons.notes: slow draw time on an already low uptime archetype, damage isn't special and no splash effect
Exotic Weapons.description: overpenetrating 3 instance shots, Truesight on ADS, +25% against Witherhoarded enemies, +10% to Taken enemies, has One for All

Exotic Weapons.name: Witherhoard
Exotic Weapons.notes: basically just used for Envious DoT
Exotic Weapons.description: projectile either sticks enemies and applies DoT or creates blight pool on ground, has buffed ALH

Exotic Weapons.name: Worldline Zero
Exotic Weapons.notes: occasionally used for Blade Focus purposes in speedrunning, otherwise basically useless
Exotic Weapons.description: special heavy blink mode that chains on kills after 1s of sprinting

Exotic Weapons.name: Xenophage
Exotic Weapons.notes: Oracles encounter one trick, not used for anything else
Exotic Weapons.description: slow-firing explosive rounds, has Chain Reaction and Rampage

Exotic Weapons.name: Ace of Spades
Exotic Weapons.notes: mathematically better than a good legendary kinetic 140 but not by much
Exotic Weapons.description: standard 140 HC with buffed Firefly and 68% damage for 6 shots on kill-reload

Exotic Weapons.name: Barrow-Dyad
Exotic Weapons.notes: no special synergies, PKs niche is gone, nothing worth exotic slot
Exotic Weapons.description: refilling SMG that stores blight into 6 high-damage seekers upon doing normal damage

Exotic Weapons.name: Black Talon
Exotic Weapons.notes: awful damage profile for boss DPS, roam has little use besides suppression source
Exotic Weapons.description: ranged double cast suppressing void slash heavy attacks, splashes suppress on slash kills

Exotic Weapons.name: Borealis
Exotic Weapons.notes: high damage per shot with Ionic Return but really never worth using
Exotic Weapons.description: element-swappable, matched effect gives 30% damage for 10s, matching shield break gives 37% crit shot, has Shield Disorient

Exotic Weapons.name: Centrifuse
Exotic Weapons.notes: movement gimmick is annoying, likely overshadowed by legendary arc autos
Exotic Weapons.description: sprinting refills, movement and shooting build charge, kills have charge-scaled explosion damage/radius, no decay while Amplified

Exotic Weapons.name: Crimson
Exotic Weapons.notes: high ammo gen but extremely outdated kit and LP stacking not relevant any more
Exotic Weapons.description: 3-burst HC that gives 32 HP and starts regen on kill, refills on crit kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Cryosthesia 77K
Exotic Weapons.notes: freeze shot no longer relevant for challenges given prominence of freeze options
Exotic Weapons.description: freezing shot on special kill-reload, refill on frozen kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Dead Man's Tale
Exotic Weapons.notes: held back by frame, single target nature, not that special
Exotic Weapons.description: aggressive scout that has up to 17% damage perk, 27% hipfire damage, and hipfire rate on crits

Exotic Weapons.name: Deathbringer
Exotic Weapons.notes: outclassed in boss DPS and for add clear
Exotic Weapons.description: slow void orb that splits into 7 falling tracking projectiles, damage scales off travel time

Exotic Weapons.name: Deterministic Chaos
Exotic Weapons.notes: not worth using over legendary void LMG, debuff extension just worse than Withering or Fafnir
Exotic Weapons.description: volatile every 4th shot, weaken every 32nd shot (bugged), refills 12 ammo on weaken shot release, has Target Lock

Exotic Weapons.name: Devil's Ruin
Exotic Weapons.notes: no CD bypass like Dragon's Breath, not as consistently lethal as better exotic primaries
Exotic Weapons.description: Firesprite on kill, high damage scorching charged laser on special reload after Firesprite pickup, has Collective Action

Exotic Weapons.name: Edge of Concurrence
Exotic Weapons.notes: seeker does a lot of damage but uptime is way too low
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire jolting chaining lightning seeker

Exotic Weapons.name: Edge of Intent
Exotic Weapons.notes: more useful than Concurrence but uptime is surprisingly not that great
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire 9s healing turret that gives Cure and Restoration to allies every 3s, ToF gives x2 to recipient

Exotic Weapons.name: Graviton Spike
Exotic Weapons.notes: cool concept and on-hit splash is good, unfortunately still too slow for endgame standards
Exotic Weapons.description: alt fire toggleable arc lightning strike or stasis crystal spawner modes, overcharge other mode every 3 crits, 20% damage for overcharging both

Exotic Weapons.name: Hard Light
Exotic Weapons.notes: can be used for specific lineups to start encounters, otherwise basically useless
Exotic Weapons.description: element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage, double ricochet, ricocheted bullets do 2x damage, has Light Touch

Exotic Weapons.name: Hawkmoon
Exotic Weapons.notes: similar situation to Dead Man's Tale
Exotic Weapons.description: crit stacking damage HC with high damage final round based on stacks

Exotic Weapons.name: Heir Apparent
Exotic Weapons.notes: arc shield melts quickly in endgame content, damage is terrible
Exotic Weapons.description: 1.5s spin-up period, creates 75% DR 80 HP arc donut shield if at full HP after ramping, refills half of mag when shield is destroyed

Exotic Weapons.name: Jötunn
Exotic Weapons.notes: awful damage profile, terrible add clear, slow pace
Exotic Weapons.description: tracking explosive projectile that leaves burning spot, has Cornered and Incandescent

Exotic Weapons.name: Lodestar
Exotic Weapons.notes: struggles against legendary traces with Harsh Refraction, not remarkable besides primary status
Exotic Weapons.description: either hipfire normal trace or ADS pulse mode that explodes on arc-debuffed kills, jolt on hit mode after charging meter via arc hits

Exotic Weapons.name: Lorentz Driver
Exotic Weapons.notes: marking gimmick is very slow tempo vs. current pace of endgame field, also not even that potent
Exotic Weapons.description: implosion on crit kill, marked targets spawn telemetries on death, 6 ammo, 50% damage, and body shot implosions for 30s on 3 pickups

Exotic Weapons.name: Malfeasance
Exotic Weapons.notes: LP use case is long gone, damage profile is mediocre, no synergy
Exotic Weapons.description: explosion on 5 hits, +25% to Taken and +25% to Witherhoarded enemies

Exotic Weapons.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
Exotic Weapons.notes: awful damage profile, has some utility for move speed boosts with relics
Exotic Weapons.description: +12.5% move speed, 4-tier buff that stacks on MIDA kills, scales to +14.4% damage and explosive shots

Exotic Weapons.name: No Time to Explain
Exotic Weapons.notes: terrible damage profile and dated add clear effect
Exotic Weapons.description: 10 crits or stasis-debuffed hits spawn buddy turret

Exotic Weapons.name: Outbreak Perfected
Exotic Weapons.notes: very slow exotic effect, awful for damage, super generation is nuked
Exotic Weapons.description: 12 crits spawn nanites, eventually scaling to 4x damage, nanite swarm spawned on kills

Exotic Weapons.name: Polaris Lance
Exotic Weapons.notes: gameplay loop too slow for endgame viability
Exotic Weapons.description: scorching solar round after 4 crits, refunds shot if crit, has Dragonfly

Exotic Weapons.name: Quicksilver Storm
Exotic Weapons.notes: on-hit stacking effect is way too slow for current exotic weapon field
Exotic Weapons.description: Nanotech Tracer Missiles version, landing hits eventually loads special reload grenade that makes tangle on kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Revision Zero
Exotic Weapons.notes: strong single target, Hunter's Trace shots do a lot, but doesn't find a niche
Exotic Weapons.description: meter filled on crits, consumed to give sniper shots that spawn kinetic shockwaves, has FTTC

Exotic Weapons.name: Ruinous Effigy
Exotic Weapons.notes: actually decent with artifact support but Wavesplitter is just better
Exotic Weapons.description: damage field slammable relic dropped on kill, 30% damage for 7s on relic kill or miniboss+ relic damage

Exotic Weapons.name: Sturm
Exotic Weapons.notes: very unremarkable exotic effect, purely single target
Exotic Weapons.description: energy weapon refill on kill, Together Forever kills load overcharged rounds (more on multikills) that do up to 4x damage

Exotic Weapons.name: SUROS Regime
Exotic Weapons.notes: purely single target, ammo effect is not nearly good enough
Exotic Weapons.description: either stable fire rate + extra heavy progress or ramping fire rate + extra special progress, has modified HIR and 50% chance to heal on kill

Exotic Weapons.name: Sweet Business
Exotic Weapons.notes: terrible minor DPS even when ramped, nothing else special
Exotic Weapons.description: ramping fire rate and massive mag, occasional explosive round, refill on brick pickup

Exotic Weapons.name: Symmetry
Exotic Weapons.notes: has unique interaction with scalable Bolt Charge, but still insanely slow tempo weapon
Exotic Weapons.description: hitscan mode builds up charge, alt fire tracking mode gets special scaling Bolt Charge and stack-scaled damage/splash

Exotic Weapons.name: Telesto
Exotic Weapons.notes: terrible damage profile, void portal effect requirements are way too steep
Exotic Weapons.description: sticky, explosive bolts, 3 void or 2 Telesto kills for refill, special reload that makes void rain portal after 3 refills

Exotic Weapons.name: The Colony
Exotic Weapons.notes: awful splash per shot, chaining way too slow
Exotic Weapons.description: seeking spider drones that blow up on enemies, kills spawn 2-6 rank-scaled drones, has ALH equivalent

Exotic Weapons.name: The Jade Rabbit
Exotic Weapons.notes: even after buffs, high-impact scout that needs more compensation to hold a candle to other meta primaries
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 crits or crit kill stack counter, can consume for micro-missile, 2x Firefly damage with stacks, has Shoot to Loot

Exotic Weapons.name: The Last Word
Exotic Weapons.notes: only potential relevance is Envious Assassin for LP dump and that is terrible
Exotic Weapons.description: 88% hipfire crit damage, has Envious Assassin

Exotic Weapons.name: The Manticore
Exotic Weapons.notes: decent with artifact but airborne mode is very gimmicky and still lacks lethality vs. better void primaries
Exotic Weapons.description: grounded hits charge meter, airborne hits consume to ramp up to 2x damage, 15 HP Void OS on airborne kill or 5 elite+ hits

Exotic Weapons.name: The Prospector
Exotic Weapons.notes: awful total and DPS, bad for add clear too
Exotic Weapons.description: shots spawn cluster bombs, has Danger Zone

Exotic Weapons.name: The Queenbreaker
Exotic Weapons.notes: similar situation to Sleeper, just worse than even other easy Particle options
Exotic Weapons.description: either 3 burst higher DPS or precision single shot blind on hit mode, has Rewind Rounds

Exotic Weapons.name: Thorn
Exotic Weapons.notes: falls significantly behind other kinetic primaries in lethality and splash application
Exotic Weapons.description: poison ticks on hit, kills create remnant that refills 4 ammo (overflow up to 40) and buffs poison damage by 3x for 7s

Exotic Weapons.name: Ticuu's Divination
Exotic Weapons.notes: doesn't synergize with subclasses or artifact very well, easy on-hit chaining but not very lethal
Exotic Weapons.description: hipfire to mark, ADS to detonate marks, impact damage scales to 87% after 6 detonations

Exotic Weapons.name: Tommy's Matchbook
Exotic Weapons.notes: splash not great, has some range issues vs. similar primaries, not very lethal
Exotic Weapons.description: scales up to +99% damage on sustained fire, slowly scorches and Cure x1 per kill after ramping

Exotic Weapons.name: Touch of Malice
Exotic Weapons.notes: significantly behind even non-Moebius Hierarchy, explicitly single target, self-damage not ideal
Exotic Weapons.description: special reload blight that buffs Weapons of Sorrow by 50%, +132% infinite final round damage, has Precision Instrument

Exotic Weapons.name: Trespasser
Exotic Weapons.notes: designed solely around single target, wasn't even given Voltshot
Exotic Weapons.description: 3x damage 6 shot burst on kill-reload

Exotic Weapons.name: Two-Tailed Fox
Exotic Weapons.notes: worse than Deathbringer, which is worse than Truth
Exotic Weapons.description: 3 multi-element homing rockets, suppress + 60-90 scorch + jolt

Exotic Weapons.name: Vigilance Wing
Exotic Weapons.notes: little to no PvE effect
Exotic Weapons.description: 5 shot burst, PvP stat buffs on ally death or solo

Exotic Weapons.name: Wicked Implement
Exotic Weapons.notes: gameplay loop too slow for modern sandbox, better legendary stasis weapons exist
Exotic Weapons.description: 4.5s slowing crit buff after 4 crits, stasis shard on crit kill or crystal shatter, overflow on shard pickup or crystal break, has Headstone

Exotic Weapons.name: Wish-Keeper
Exotic Weapons.notes: 6 stack counter way too slow for current sandbox, payoff isn't even great either
Exotic Weapons.description: 6 crit or kill (elite+ gives 2) counter, hipfire to consume and create suspend snare, +50% damage to suspended enemies

aion adapter.piece2Desc: Final blows with any Rocket or Grenade Launcher temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
aion adapter.piece2Numbers: After a Micromissile, Rocket Launcher, or Grenade Launcher Kill: 20% AOE Damage Resist and 60% self-explosive Damage Resist for 15 Seconds
aion adapter.piece4Desc: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
aion adapter.piece4Numbers: This disorienting burst can only be triggered ONCE per Reactive Shock activation

aion renewal.piece2Desc: After a final blow with any Rocket or Grenade Launcher, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
aion renewal.piece2Numbers: After a Micromissile, Rocket Launcher, or Grenade Launcher Kill: Grants force converter, granting speed boost
aion renewal.piece4Desc: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
aion renewal.piece4Numbers: This benefit can only trigger ONCE per Force Converter Activation

apostate's blade.piece2Desc: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
apostate's blade.piece2Numbers: Grants Regenerative Threshold on Finisher. When reaching Critical Health, consumes Regenerative Threshold and grants 20 HP and begins Health Regeneration.
apostate's blade.piece4Desc: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
apostate's blade.piece4Numbers: While Radiant, Resoration, or Cure are active: The tiggered Solar Blast deals 28 Damage and inflicts 30 (+10 ashes) scorch within 7? meters

atheon's memory.piece2Desc: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
atheon's memory.piece2Numbers: Damage is very minimal. Play for the 4 piece bonus
atheon's memory.piece4Desc: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
atheon's memory.piece4Numbers: Orb Appears at feet. Great for damage self-sustain via orbs

bushido.piece2Desc: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
bushido.piece2Numbers: Kills Restore 35 HP. There is a 3 second Cooldown between perk activation.
bushido.piece4Desc: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
bushido.piece4Numbers: Resist x1 (10%) for 7 seconds. Additional damage extends buff by +2 seconds with maximum of 9 seconds.

circuit.piece2Desc: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
circuit.piece2Numbers: Stacks accumulate at 1 per 5 seconds (45 seconds total) up to 10x stacks (+45% HP/s). Each stack grants increased Critical Health Regeneration Speed, NOT Shields. When slow, stacks deplete at 4x stacks/second
circuit.piece4Desc: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.

coda.piece2Desc: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
coda.piece2Numbers: Light/Dark polarity for 10 seconds a stack, 5 stacks max, 8 stat per stack up to a max of +40 stat. ALL stacks removed when polarity changes on opposite polarity weapon kill
coda.piece4Desc: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
coda.piece4Numbers: In addition to the stats provided by 2-piece, chunk-ability gains AND 40% DR for 5 seconds as long as you play the rotating elements mini-game is amazing

collective psyche.piece2Desc: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
collective psyche.piece2Numbers: Stacks up to 20x. Persist through death. Special grants 1 stack, Heavy 3 stacks. Bonus to ready/stow speeds at maximum is .8x Ready/Stow Animation duration at 20 stacks.
collective psyche.piece4Desc: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
collective psyche.piece4Numbers: Duration increase is 50% longer with Ember of Solace or Thread of Continuity boosting benefit to 70%

crota's memory.piece2Desc: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
crota's memory.piece2Numbers: Radius of explosion is 4.5 meters. No? internal cooldown. Explosion is ARC damage.
crota's memory.piece4Desc: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
crota's memory.piece4Numbers: Similar to Frenzy requirements for combat (Deal/recieve damage every 7 seconds). After 12 Seconds, gain 15% Damage Resist + Flinch Resist. After 24 Seconds, gain 25% Damage Resist + Flinch Resist.

cruel electrum.piece2Desc: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
cruel electrum.piece4Desc: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.

crystocrene.piece2Desc: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
crystocrene.piece2Numbers: Triggers EVERY 12 seconds no matter what; seems like a bug but likely will not get patched. free ammo progress + orbs is very good and benefits increase the less you are in combat.
crystocrene.piece4Desc: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
crystocrene.piece4Numbers: Does not have the same functionality of "being out of combat" as the 2-piece. Extremely extremley niche, borderline PVP

cyberserpent null.piece2Desc: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
cyberserpent null.piece4Desc: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.

dark age.piece2Desc: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
dark age.piece2Numbers: Initiative stacks up to 5x  and lasts for 8 seconds per stack, decaying 1 at a time
dark age.piece4Desc: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
dark age.piece4Numbers: Upon Class ability usage, deploys stationary Healling Drone that heals every 2 seconds. Health restored is +10 HP (+50 HP Max) per initiative stack and can pulse up to 5 times per Class Ability use

deep explorer.piece2Desc: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
deep explorer.piece2Numbers: Stacks to 10x. Self Damage does not count. ~+50 reload speed and ~.85x -.9x Reload Duration Multiplier at MAX stacks
deep explorer.piece4Desc: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
deep explorer.piece4Numbers: ~+35 HP at 1 stack (Full Heal at >8x stacks) Healing seems to be inconsistent and can provided substantially more health sometimes.

disaster corps.piece2Desc: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
disaster corps.piece2Numbers: Healing is 20 HP/s after reloading within 3 seconds of a kill. Lasts until any "combat" action is taken (ability use, weapon, class, super, take damage).
disaster corps.piece4Desc: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
disaster corps.piece4Numbers: Grants +20 Range, +20 Stability, +30 Reload Speed, and .9x Reload Duration Multiplier to listed weapons for 11 seconds.

dreambane.piece2Desc: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
dreambane.piece2Numbers: Buff triggers on elite+, lasts for 15 seconds, and grants +30 to melee and grenade stat.
dreambane.piece4Desc: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
dreambane.piece4Numbers: While buff is active, 8 damage instances  within 3 seconds each (only counted once per .45 seconds) Begins Critical Health Regeneration and restores 20 HP. 2 second internal cooldown.

eutechnology.piece2Desc: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
eutechnology.piece2Numbers: Requirement is 3 Void kills within 5 seconds of each other.
eutechnology.piece4Desc: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
eutechnology.piece4Numbers: Techeun's Foresight granted on collecting void breach: next void weapon  kill triggers a 3 meter Void detonation for 87 Damage. If Void breach collection is rapid, grants Techeun's Clairvoyance: next void weapon kill triggers a 5 meter Void detonation for 173 damage

exodus down.piece2Desc: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
exodus down.piece2Numbers: Radius is 10 meters. Picking up multiple orbs will grant multiple stacks of 4-piece Repurposed charge buff.
exodus down.piece4Desc: Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time. This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
exodus down.piece4Numbers: Grants +5 HP per Armor charge change, with duration = 3 seconds * stacks. The change scales based off SIMULTANEOUS gains/loses. Maxes out at x7 stacks. x2 = 13% DR, x3 =21% DR, x4 = 29.5% DR, x7 = 35% DR

ferropotent.piece2Desc: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
ferropotent.piece2Numbers: Grants 10% Damage Resist and ? flinch resist for 7 seconds
ferropotent.piece4Desc: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type. Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
ferropotent.piece4Numbers: Primary's grant +3% special progess and Special's grant +2% Heavy ammo progress on Low Ammo Reserves.

first ascent.piece2Desc: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
first ascent.piece2Numbers: Buff duration is 24 seconds, refreshed on unique elemental kill. CANNOT refresh once all 5 elements have been utilized.
first ascent.piece4Desc: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
first ascent.piece4Numbers: Grants 6% Prismatic Grenade energy per stack of Stack 'Em up used up to 30% at maximum.

flain.piece2Desc: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
flain.piece4Desc: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.

great hunt.piece2Desc: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
great hunt.piece2Numbers: Grants Damage Resist x1 (10%) for 7 seconds
great hunt.piece4Desc: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.

iron battalion.piece2Desc: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
iron battalion.piece2Numbers: Damage bonus is around 12.5% bonus damage against non-boss combatants at 200 Weapons Stat compared to 100 Weapons Stat. Does NOT affect boss combatants.
iron battalion.piece4Desc: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
iron battalion.piece4Numbers: Returns up to 30% super based on kills in super/with super. Works with Well of Radiance, works with bubble (melee kills holding bubble ONLY), does stack with super-generating exotics, enemy tier scales super gains to maximum 30% quicker. Around 6 red bar kills for max gains

iron panoply.piece2Desc: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
iron panoply.piece2Numbers: Grants +30 HP on weapon kills when shields broke. 5 Second internal cooldown.
iron panoply.piece4Desc: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
iron panoply.piece4Numbers: Grants +35 ammo Regeneration stat, 15% Damage resist against Combatants within 15 meters for 7 seconds. Additional kills refresh buff duration. Buff cant retrigger until any shield has been recovered.

kentarch 3.piece2Desc: Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
kentarch 3.piece4Desc: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

last discipline.piece2Desc: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
last discipline.piece2Numbers: Grants +20 reload speed and .95x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons for 6 Seconds. Triggers on Constructs as well.
last discipline.piece4Desc: Picking up an Orb of Power grants special ammo progress.
last discipline.piece4Numbers: Grants 6% Special Ammo Progress on Orb pickup.

legacy's oath.piece2Desc: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
legacy's oath.piece2Numbers: Disorient triggers .67 seconds after combatant death in a 10 meter radius that applies Disorient for 2.5 Seconds.
legacy's oath.piece4Desc: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
legacy's oath.piece4Numbers: Critical Health releases 2 680 Damage micromissiles while casting super releases 4 680 Damage micromissiles.

luminopotent.piece2Desc: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
luminopotent.piece4Desc: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.

lustrous.piece2Desc: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
lustrous.piece2Numbers: Grants +20 Handling, + 10 Reload Speed, .85x Reload Duration Multipler and Flinch resist for Solar weapons upon ANY sources of healing while not at full HP
lustrous.piece4Desc: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
lustrous.piece4Numbers: Grants +35 HP after 3 Solar kills within 3 seconds of each other. Small internal cooldown.

new demotic.piece2Desc: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
new demotic.piece4Desc: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.

nezarec's nightmare.piece2Desc: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
nezarec's nightmare.piece2Numbers: Requires 3 elementally debuffed kills to spawn an orb. No internal cooldown?
nezarec's nightmare.piece4Desc: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
nezarec's nightmare.piece4Numbers: Grants Devour for 6 (+3) Seconds, while Devour is active, gain +20% Damage Resist against Combatants.

oryx's memory.piece2Desc: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
oryx's memory.piece2Numbers: 12% special ammo progress and 8% power ammo progress on elite+ kill
oryx's memory.piece4Desc: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.

pantheos resplendent.piece2Desc: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
pantheos resplendent.piece2Numbers: Grants 1x Armor Charge on ammo brick pick up. Each Armor charge stack grants +10 Health Stat, maxing out at +60 Health Stat at x6 Armor Charge
pantheos resplendent.piece4Desc: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
pantheos resplendent.piece4Numbers: Stacks up to 10x, grants 15% bonus Damage against Orange bar and lower enemies. Each kill consumes 1 stack.

per audacia.piece2Desc: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
per audacia.piece4Desc: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
per audacia.piece4Numbers: grants +20 mobility, 6.25% sprint speed boost and 33% slide distance

promised.piece2Desc: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
promised.piece2Numbers: Grants 7% increased damage and 25% Damage Resist for 12 Seconds on Orange bar+ kill
promised.piece4Desc: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
promised.piece4Numbers: Dealing ~600 Damage triggers an 8-meter radius Exhausting Blast that deals damage and inflicts exhaustion. ~2 second internal cooldown.

resonant fury.piece2Desc: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
resonant fury.piece2Numbers: Health Regeneration Triggers on Miniboss+ melee hits
resonant fury.piece4Desc: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
resonant fury.piece4Numbers: Stacks up to 5x. Consumes all stacks on weapon stow and Heals +30 HP per stack consumed.

reverie dawn.piece2Desc: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.
reverie dawn.piece2Numbers: Buff duration is 7 seconds and incurs a 5 second internal cooldown before it can be triggered again
reverie dawn.piece4Desc: When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.

sage protector.piece2Desc: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
sage protector.piece2Numbers: Grants 3% Grenade and Class Ability enrgy per Sword Hit. Bonus increase to 8% with Blase Focus Active.
sage protector.piece4Desc: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
sage protector.piece4Numbers: After guarding for 1.35 seconds then hitting a target, grants Blade focus: +10% bonus sword damage, +100% sword lunge range, buff duration 7 seconds or on sword guard or stow.

seventh seraph.piece2Desc: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
seventh seraph.piece2Numbers: Stacks up to 10x with a duration of 10 seconds. All stacks disappear on expiration. Each stack grants +3 grenade stat and +3 weapon stat up to +30 maximum for each
seventh seraph.piece4Desc: While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
seventh seraph.piece4Numbers: On Elite+ Kill: Damage is 405 Solar Damage, restoring +50HP to user and allies over 10 meters. On Construct Kill: ~half damage and health over same radius. Warmind detonations can grant warmind stacks but not chain into other warmind detonations. .3 second internal cooldown.

shrewd survivor.piece2Desc: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
shrewd survivor.piece2Numbers: Duration is 1.5 seconds. Dealing damage extends duration. Grants +50 handling, .6x Ready Duration Multiplier, and -2.5% Accuracy Cone Size for 1.5 seconds
shrewd survivor.piece4Desc: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
shrewd survivor.piece4Numbers: Scoring a kill grants Hotshot for 10 seconds: +15 Stability, +20 Reload Speed, Bonus Aim Assist, and +30 Weapons stat

smoke jumper.piece2Desc: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
smoke jumper.piece2Numbers: Buff duration is 3 seconds. Initially grants 40% DR, scales down to 30% within 1.5 seconds and is further reduces to 24% with 1 second left, decreasing to 0% at no time remaining.
smoke jumper.piece4Desc: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
smoke jumper.piece4Numbers: Grants 16% Special Ammo Progress and restores +35 HP on elite+ finisher

spacewalk.piece2Desc: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
spacewalk.piece2Numbers: The damage bonus is +15% against disoriented combatants, but does NOT work with Arc Blind.
spacewalk.piece4Desc: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.

swordmaster.piece2Desc: Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
swordmaster.piece4Desc: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
swordmaster.piece4Numbers: Upon Blocking, grants 50% Damage Resist for 3 seconds after Guard is dropped. No internal Cooldown.

taken king.piece2Desc: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
taken king.piece2Numbers: Duration of Ceremony is 30 Seconds. Buff can be refreshed up to a max of 30 seconds. Grants + 30 Super Stat while active.
taken king.piece4Desc: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
taken king.piece4Numbers: Scoring 2 ability kills spawns a Loyal Arc moth with 8 second duration. The moth chases enemies within 60+ meters and deal 180 damage, inflcting blind for 8 seconds over ~6 meters. All means of Bolt Charge discharge trigger can spawn the moth (except praxic blade).

techeun's regalia.piece2Desc: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
techeun's regalia.piece2Numbers: Grants a +200 HP Overshield for the duration of the finisher. The slow radius is 7 meters
techeun's regalia.piece4Desc: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
techeun's regalia.piece4Numbers: Each Damage instance scored grants Truth stacks, up to x999 stacks. Kills/finishers grant more stacks. Truth grants Damage Resist: x250 = 3.75%, x500 = 7.5%, x750 = 10%, x999 = 15%. At x999, turns into power, which boosts Ability Regeneration Rate on top of the DR.

techsec.piece2Desc: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
techsec.piece2Numbers: Passively grants +200% increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields and Overshields. 15% increased Kinetic Damage towards Constructs.
techsec.piece4Desc: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
techsec.piece4Numbers: Disorienting Blast deals 162 Kinetic Damage, Heavy staggering, and inflicts disorient in a 10 meter radius.

thriving survivor.piece2Desc: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
thriving survivor.piece4Desc: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
thriving survivor.piece4Numbers: Triggers upon scoring 3 kills within 4 seconds of each and grants Room Clearing: Buff duration is 10 seconds and grants +40 Grenade and +40 Weapons Stat and +40 ammo generation for Heat/primary ammo weapons.

thunderhead.piece2Desc: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
thunderhead.piece2Numbers: Buff can stack up to x10 and lasts for 15 seconds. Quicksilver Storm micromissiles do synergize. Damage Resist at x1 stack is 12% against enemies within 5 meters. This scales up to 30% Damage Resist at max stacks.
thunderhead.piece4Desc: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
thunderhead.piece4Numbers: Grants +10% grenade energy on kill OR +10% special ammo progress if grenade is already full

tm custom.piece2Desc: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
tm custom.piece2Numbers: ~+40 HP restored and 12 meter radius on disorient. 2 second internal cooldown
tm custom.piece4Desc: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
tm custom.piece4Numbers: Grants +7% increased Precision Damage against Combatants for 3 Seconds. Bonus Doubles to +15% for Tex weapons Origin trait weapons and exotics, including DMT, Huckleberry, Lasy Word, Tarrabah, Chaperone, and Prospector.

triumphal anthem.piece2Desc: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
triumphal anthem.piece2Numbers: 15 meter radius and 10 second buff duration
triumphal anthem.piece4Desc: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
triumphal anthem.piece4Numbers: 3 second duration and +33% slide distance. 50% Damage resist while sliding

twofold crown.piece2Desc: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
twofold crown.piece2Numbers: Grants +70 HP on Ammo Brich Pickup
twofold crown.piece4Desc: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
twofold crown.piece4Numbers: Duration is 5 seconds and can trigger off constucts.

veritas.piece2Desc: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
veritas.piece2Numbers: Requires a finisher or 2 melee final blows (small .2 second cooldown between kills for some reason. DOES NOTHING if Strand/Stasis super is equipped.
veritas.piece4Desc: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
veritas.piece4Numbers: On elite+ finisher, Restores +50 HP and spawns 3 Loyal Void Moths that grant 22.5 HP Void Overshield to user and allies on impact.

wayward psyche.piece2Desc: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
wayward psyche.piece4Desc: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
wayward psyche.piece4Numbers: Restores +30 HP/S for 11 seconds as long as you are moving.

wild anthem.piece2Desc: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
wild anthem.piece2Numbers: While ammo is <= 50% or Magazine AND Ammo isnt 0, +15 Reload Speed and .95x Reload Duration Multiplier. Does not work with Bows, GLs, or Rockets (unless magazine isnt 1).
wild anthem.piece4Desc: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
wild anthem.piece4Numbers: After reload, +30 handling and some flinch resistance for 6 seconds. The Range benefit for the origin trait is +15 Range. Persists through stow only on the weapon it was initially triggered on.

wildwood.piece2Desc: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
wildwood.piece2Numbers: After a kill, Grants Resist x2 (25% Damage Resist) until no longer ADS
wildwood.piece4Desc: Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration. Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
